main_text.p: Duo in io continentur 5, & 5 in femicirculo noto,& dico:bis 5 sunt io,quæ subscripta subtraho. remanet nihil.
Promoveo Divisorem, inquiens: 2 in o non continentur: scribo o in femicirculo, ac subtraho 2 à o, & remanet nihil.
Transfero Divisorem, dicens:2 in o non continentur: scribo o in semicirculo, & subtraho 2 à o & remanet nihil. Centum ergo libræ emuntur 500 albis.
Nunc albi in aureos sunt ducendi per duos Divisores, nempe 26 hoc modo:
Duo in 5 continentur 1, noto 1 in semicirculo, & subtraho 2 à 5 & remanent 3, 2 scribo, unum sequenti notæ præpono, dicens,6 à 10,remanent 4, quæ supra noto.

Transfero Divisores, dicens 2 in 24 continentur 9,& 9 in semicirculo noto,dicens, Sexies 9 sunt 54. subnoto 4,& 5 retineo,ac pergo inquiens,bis 9 sunt 18, additis 5, sunt 23,quę subscripta subtraho,& 2 à 2 remanet nihil, 3 à 4 remanet 1, quod sequenti notæ præpono, inquiens, 4 à 10 remanent 6,

page.notes: The small symbols above "(500" are ornamental counter-marks of the calculation figure; their exact shapes are uncertain and are marked [?]. The division layout "5 o o (" with "2 6" is set in the printed arrangement. The catchword "quæ" stands alone at lower right and is not repeated in the text. The page ends mid-sentence and continues on the next page.
